plainText:
Ed Bosco is an American actor for the English-language dub of and .

==Biography==
Bosco was born on January 24, 1986, in Chicago, Illinois, and became a voice actor as an adult. Bosco first worked on Pokémon by voicing characters in and Pokémon: Twilight Wings before joining the during . During Journeys, Bosco was credited as Edward Bosco before becoming credited as Ed Bosco in .
